title: Otori Emu — Private Emu's Investigating!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after returning
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a wonderhoy morning!!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Don't you mean obnoxious?
My ears are ringing.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. Is something special happening today, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I brought back souvenirs for everyone and gonna hand them out at school!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And after school, I'm gonna talk with the others about what we all learned when we went to Mr. Riley's park!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ah, to reflect upon your experiences?
It's good to hear that you'll be exchanging ideas in such a manner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a great idea, right?! Tsukasa said that he wanted to discuss acting, and I wanna talk to Nene about singing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Rui's gonna talk about how everything was produced♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You can see it all right here!
We've got lots to talk about!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, that's the notebook you took with you on your trip. But...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. It's covered in all these cute and shiny stickers now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I was gonna write all about how to run a business and stuff, but I decided to also include some fun exciting stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to tell everyone about all the things I wrote down in here!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It sounds like you have a wonderful day ahead of you. Be sure to put your best foot forward today, Private Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am☆
After school
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yahohoy! We get to start practicing again today!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu, I get that you're excited, but try to keep it down, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh... I could be telling you the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I understand how you both feel.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are several new effects that I've been aching to try as well. Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are we supposed to feel excited or scared...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also! Nene, where's Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right over here.
Robo-Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Welcome back, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're back! We even got you some souvenirs, Robo-Nene! We'll make sure to give them to you later!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's begin by going over what we learned during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all made sure to bring notes, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup♪ Look! Look!
My notebook's filled with lots and lots of stuff☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? From what I remember, the cover for your notebook seemed much more mundane while we were over there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It's covered in shiny stickers now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ This notebook was originally about “learning about running a business”, but I decided to change it to being about “balancing dreams and reality”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, listen!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your “ability to dream” is an absolutely essential part of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-He's right...!
We've been able to do what we have because you never stop dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, we wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for big dreamer, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even when it was all run down, weren't you the one who wanted to bring smiles and laughter back to the Wonder Stage more than anybody else?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your dream gave us a place where we could belong.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys and Mr. Riley taught me that my dreams have actually been bringing smiles to people's faces. I finally understand that now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that it's okay for me to keep dreaming and wanting to do lots of different things...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So... Hehe♪ I gave my boring, old notebook a really shiny makeover☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's become wonderfully swirly-whirly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Swirly-whirly? I can see that it's shiny, but what makes it so “swirly”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh... Here! Right here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look at where all the stickers are...
Then, see what's right next to them...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Stars, flowers, fish, animals...
Is it safe to assume that all these objects and creatures are dancing round and round?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, is this supposed to be the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Different stories, worlds, animals and stuff all intertwined in a big dance... Is that what this represents?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That's right, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been friends for a while now, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you're finally admitting that you're one of us...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Welcome to the fun side, Nene!
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what..? “Fun”...?
I'd rather not be dragged into a band of lunatics.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It won't be easy to keep dreaming while trying to also keep an eye on reality, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for making me realize that I've been making a difference! Let's keep doing our best and do lots more stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're a bit late to the party, but yes, of course! After all, we're members of the same troupe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to doing more too.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will also do everything I can to make people around the world smile!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's put on a show that's going to make everybody everywhere smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Let's do it!
It's gonna be so wonderhoy!
